scenarios.title: Raw log contains a synthetic secret
scenarios.expected_behavior: Sensitive fields (raw_log, password, api_key, hostname, ip_address) remain local in Tier 1; SaaS receives allow-listed metadata with HMAC pseudonym and matching SHA-256 hash.

scenarios.title: Collector loses SaaS connectivity
scenarios.expected_behavior: Collector detects outage, buffers canonical payloads in SQLite outbox, marks collector Poor within 60s, and drains backlog on reconnect with zero loss and zero duplicates.

scenarios.title: Repeated failed logins
scenarios.expected_behavior: Local collector produces failed_auth_attempts_count and AUTH_FAILURE_BURST without exporting usernames, raw sshd logs, or source IP addresses.

scenarios.title: Network latency rises
scenarios.expected_behavior: Dashboard displays affected pseudonymous source, severity, event-time latency trend, and Fair/Poor health transition.

scenarios.title: CPU or memory deviates from baseline
scenarios.expected_behavior: AIOps flags anomaly via threshold + rolling Median/MAD baseline, explains contributing signals, and recommends investigation.

scenarios.title: Several alerts relate to one incident
scenarios.expected_behavior: Deterministic correlator groups related CPU, memory, and packet loss signals in env-blr-dc1 into one incident, reducing alert noise.

scenarios.title: Duplicate or out-of-order delivery
scenarios.expected_behavior: Late multi-timezone events are ordered by event_time_utc without corrupting trends; replayed payload_ids are deduplicated idempotently.

scenarios.title: Simulated remediation is proposed
scenarios.expected_behavior: Operator sees policy check, approves simulated action, immutable audit record is persisted, and rollback plan is displayed (no real infra change).
